text: Cross-reference policy distinction: native PM/mKH GroupModel.mixedEffects estimates Paule-Mandel tau2 per study. Historical Python dcrit_ladder.py supplied vhat + true tau2 to pm_mkh_batch instead. For true tau2=0, all 72 native-vs-Python cell rejection differences were under 2.50 combined binomial SE; for tau2=0.2, 45/72 exceeded 3 SE (max 9.14). Native conditional dCrit=12 is its own group-policy result, not exact cross-provider parity or a production defect.
